spellSeeds.name: Ember Lash
spellSeeds.description: You lash out with a thin whip of fire at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes fire damage.

spellSeeds.name: Frostbite Touch
spellSeeds.description: You channel biting cold through your hand. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, the target takes cold damage.

spellSeeds.name: Mind Splinter
spellSeeds.description: You drive a splinter of pure thought into a creature's mind. The target must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or take psychic damage.

spellSeeds.name: Guiding Word
spellSeeds.description: You speak a word of guidance to a creature you can see. The next time the target makes an ability check or attack roll before the spell ends, it can add 1d4 to the roll.
spellSeeds.atHigherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

spellSeeds.name: Grasping Roots
spellSeeds.description: Roots and vines erupt from the ground in a 10-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained until the spell ends.
spellSeeds.atHigherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the radius increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 1st.

spellSeeds.name: Warding Glimmer
spellSeeds.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when you or a creature within 30 feet is hit by an attack
spellSeeds.description: A flicker of protective light surrounds the target, imposing a -2 penalty to the attack roll that triggered this spell, potentially causing the attack to miss.
spellSeeds.atHigherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

spellSeeds.name: Veil of Whispers
spellSeeds.description: You surround yourself with faint, directionless whispering sounds. Creatures trying to pinpoint your location by sound have disadvantage on the check, and you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on sound.

spellSeeds.name: Scorching Wave
spellSeeds.description: A wave of heat rolls out from you in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.
spellSeeds.atHigherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2nd.

spellSeeds.name: Binding Sigil
spellSeeds.description: A shimmering sigil appears around a creature you can see, forcing a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target's speed is halved and it can't take reactions until the spell ends.
spellSeeds.atHigherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each two slot levels above 3rd.

spellSeeds.name: Chorus of Mending
spellSeeds.description: Choose up to three creatures within range. Each regains a number of hit points.
spellSeeds.atHigherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

spellSeeds.name: Wall of Ashes
spellSeeds.description: You create a wall of choking ash and cinders up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The area within and adjacent to the wall is heavily obscured, and creatures that end their turn adjacent to it take fire damage.
spellSeeds.atHigherLevels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the wall's length increases by 10 feet for each slot level above 4th.

spellSeeds.name: Call the Steady Tide
spellSeeds.description: You summon a surge of water that fills a 20-foot cube within range. The area becomes difficult terrain, and creatures that start their turn in it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

spellSeeds.name: Unmaking Word
spellSeeds.description: You speak a single syllable no living throat should manage. One creature you can see must make a Constitution saving throw, taking necrotic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

spellSeeds.name: Sanctuary of the Long Watch
spellSeeds.description: You warded a 20-foot radius area centered on a point you touch. Until the spell ends, creatures hostile to you or your allies that try to enter the area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be unable to enter.

_genreNote: spellSeeds/flavorTemplates deliberately stay universal, not genre-split -- a spellcasting system existing at all already implies SOME fantastical framing (arcane magic, psionics, half-understood old-world tech), and this pool's existing wording ('a lineage of casters', 'an older name... in a dialect nobody teaches anymore') already reads fine whether that framing is high fantasy, post-apocalyptic remnant-magic, or sci-fi psionics -- unlike weapon names, there's no single-word swap that makes a spell concept read distinctly post_apoc vs scifi vs modern.

flavorTemplates.value: {name} was passed down through a lineage of casters who never agreed on much else.
{name} reads like it was written by someone in a hurry, and cast by someone even more so.
There's an older name for {name} in a dialect nobody teaches anymore.
{name} shows up in more than one tradition's spellbook, each claiming to have invented it first.

designNotes.value: Procedurally rolled from a fixed seed pool -- description/flavor are template-generated, worth a manual polish pass before running it at the table.
